items.passage: Mina keeps a small notebook in her coat pocket. On the bus, she writes down one new word from a sign or a poster. At night, she reads **it** aloud to her younger brother. He laughs at the strange sounds, but he remembers many of the words. Now both of them know the names of every stop on the line.
items.explanation: 둘째 문장에서 미나는 버스에서 새 단어 하나를 적는다고 했다.

items.passage: Mina keeps a small notebook in her coat pocket. On the bus, she writes down one new word from a sign or a poster. At night, she reads **it** aloud to her younger brother. He laughs at the strange sounds, but he remembers many of the words. Now both of them know the names of every stop on the line.
items.explanation: 바로 앞 문장에서 적은 새 단어를 밤에 소리 내어 읽는다.

items.passage: Mina keeps a small notebook in her coat pocket. On the bus, she writes down one new word from a sign or a poster. At night, she reads **it** aloud to her younger brother. He laughs at the strange sounds, but he remembers many of the words. Now both of them know the names of every stop on the line.
items.stem: 글을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 조합은?
items.prompt_text: Mina collects new (A) ____ on the bus and shares them with her (B) ____.
items.explanation: 버스에서 단어를 모아 남동생에게 읽어 준다는 내용이다.

items.passage: Our town opens a night market every Saturday in summer. ① Farmers bring fresh fruit and sell it from small tables. ② Children play simple games and win tiny prizes. ③ Musicians play near the gate until the market ends. ④ The town library closes early on Mondays.
items.explanation: ①~③은 야시장에서 벌어지는 일이고, ④는 도서관 이야기다.

items.given: Jun wanted to grow tomatoes on his balcony, so he bought three small plants.
items.passage:
(A) After that change, new green leaves appeared within a week.

(B) At first, however, the leaves turned yellow because the pots stood in the shade all day.

(C) To solve this problem, he moved the pots to the sunny side of the balcony.
items.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explanation: (B)의 however가 주어진 글과 대조되고, (C)의 this problem은 (B)의 노란 잎, (A)의 that change는 (C)의 화분 옮기기를 가리킨다.

items.given: That is why she now leaves home ten minutes earlier.
items.passage: Sora walks to school every morning. ( ① ) Since a new bakery opened on her street, the smell of warm bread makes her stop at the window each day. ( ② ) She still arrives at school before the first bell. ( ③ ) Her friends wait for her at the gate. ( ④ )
items.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
items.explanation: That is why가 가리키는 이유(빵집 앞에서 멈춤)가 바로 앞에 있고, 뒤 문장의 still이 일찍 나선 결과와 이어진다.
distractor_notes: 글의 끝이라 뒤 문장과 이어지지 않음

items.passage: A school club wanted more students to borrow books. Instead of making a long list of rules, the members put one shelf near the front door and changed its books every week. Soon, more students stopped to look. The club learned that people read more when ____.
items.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explanation: 문 가까이에 책장을 두자 학생들이 멈춰 보았다는 결과가 근거다.
distractor_notes: 규칙 목록 대신 다른 방법을 썼음

items.passage: We plant seeds in the school garden every spring. First, we dig small holes in the (가) ____. Then we pour (나) ____ on them every morning. When the sun is strong, the plants grow tall and green (다) ____ appear.
items.stem: 보기에서 알맞은 단어를 골라 빈칸에 하나씩 쓰시오.
items.explanation: 구멍을 파는 곳은 흙, 붓는 것은 물, 자라면서 나오는 초록색은 잎이다.

items.passage: It was very cold this morning, so I put on my (A)【gloves / sandals】. The road was covered with ice, and I walked (B)【slowly / quickly】 to stay safe. At school, I held a cup of hot tea to make my hands (C)【warm / wet】.
items.stem: (A), (B), (C)의 네모 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말을 고른 조합은?
items.explanation: 추워서 장갑을 끼고, 얼음길이라 천천히 걷고, 뜨거운 차로 손을 따뜻하게 한다.

items.passage: The museum is ____ on Mondays, so we will visit it on Tuesday instead.
items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explanation: 화요일에 대신 간다는 말(instead)이 월요일에는 갈 수 없다는 단서다.

items.stem: 왼쪽 단어에 알맞은 영어 뜻풀이를 오른쪽에서 찾아 기호를 쓰시오.
match_right: a place where people buy and sell things
a dark area where sunlight does not reach
a small bag sewn into your clothes
a metal object that rings to tell the time
a road that goes over a river

items.stem: 다음 단어의 문맥상 우리말 뜻을 쓰시오.
